units.literal: Chong then sent guards officer Li Yun with a letter begging that Yun be returned to his domain. When Yun had already died he answered only with gracious words.

units.zh: 周廣順元年正月，崇僭號於河東，稱漢，改名旻，仍以乾祐為年號。
units.en: In the first month of Zhou Guangshun's first year Chong usurped rule in Hedong as Han, renamed himself Min, and kept the era Qianyou.
units.literal: In the first month of the first year of Guangshun of Zhou, Chong usurped a title in Hedong, calling his state Han, changed his name to Min, and still used Qianyou as the era name.

units.zh: 署其子承鈞為侍衛親軍都指揮使、太原尹，以判官鄭拱、趙華為宰相，副使李瑰、代州刺史張暉為腹心，尋遣承鈞率兵攻晉、隰二州，不克而退。
units.en: He made his son Chengjun guard commander and Prefect of Taiyuan, Zheng Gong and Zhao Hua grand councilors, Li Gui and Zhang Hui of Daizhou his intimates, then sent Chengjun against Jin and Xi; failing, he withdrew.
units.literal: He appointed his son Chengjun commander of the palace guard and Prefect of Taiyuan, made adjutants Zheng Gong and Zhao Hua grand councilors, and made vice-commissioner Li Gui and Daizhou prefect Zhang Hui his inner circle. Soon he sent Chengjun to lead troops against Jin and Xi prefectures; they could not be taken and he withdrew.

units.zh: 九月，崇自領兵由陰地關寇晉州，乞師於契丹，契丹以五千騎助之，合兵以攻平陽，又分兵寇昭義。
units.en: In the ninth month Chong led troops through Yindi Pass against Jinzhou, begged Khitan aid, and received five thousand horse. They attacked Pingyang and raided Zhaoyi.
units.literal: In the ninth month Chong personally led troops through Yindi Pass to raid Jinzhou, begged troops from the Khitans, and the Khitans sent five thousand horse to help. They united to attack Pingyang and also divided troops to raid Zhaoyi.

units.zh: 周太祖遣樞密使王峻等率大軍以援晉、絳，崇聞周師至，遂焚營而遁。
units.en: The Zhou founder sent Wang Jun with a great army to relieve Jin and Jiang. Hearing of it, Chong burned his camp and fled.
units.literal: The Zhou founder sent Grand Marshal Wang Jun and others with a great army to relieve Jin and Jiang. When Chong heard Zhou troops had come he burned his camp and fled.

units.zh: 是歲，晉、絳大雪，崇駐軍六十餘日，邊民走險自固，兵無所掠，士有饑色，比至太原，十亡三四。
units.en: That year snow lay heavy on Jin and Jiang. Chong camped sixty days while the border people fled to the hills; his men went hungry, and three or four in ten died before Taiyuan.
units.literal: That year Jin and Jiang had heavy snow. Chong encamped more than sixty days; border people fled to rugged places and fortified themselves, so the army had nothing to plunder and the men showed hunger. By the time they reached Taiyuan, three or four in ten had perished.

units.zh: 二年二月，崇遣兵三千餘眾寇府州，為折德扆所破，其所部岢嵐軍為德扆所取。
units.en: In the second month of the second year he sent three thousand men against Fuzhou; Zhe Dewei defeated them and took his Keilan army.
units.literal: In the second month of the second year Chong sent more than three thousand troops to raid Fuzhou and was defeated by Zhe Dewei; his subordinate Keilan Army was also taken by Dewei.

units.zh: 崇自僭稱之後，以重幣求援於契丹，仍稱侄以事之，契丹偽冊為英武皇帝。
units.en: After usurping he bought Khitan aid with heavy gifts, called himself their nephew, and received false investiture as Martial Emperor.
units.literal: After his usurpation Chong used heavy bribes to seek aid from the Khitans and still styled himself nephew in serving them; the Khitans falsely invested him as Martial and Martial Emperor.

units.zh: 及周世宗嗣位，崇復乞師於契丹，以圖入寇，契丹遣將楊袞合勢大舉，來迫潞州。
units.en: When Zhou Shizong succeeded, Chong again begged Khitan aid; Yang Gun marched in force on Luzhou.
units.literal: When Emperor Shizong of Zhou succeeded, Chong again begged Khitan troops intending invasion; the Khitans sent General Yang Gun in a great combined advance pressing Luzhou.

units.zh: 顯德元年三月，周世宗親征，與崇戰於高平，大敗之。
units.en: In the third month of Xiande's first year Shizong campaigned in person and routed Chong at Gaoping.
units.literal: In the third month of the first year of Xiande, Emperor Shizong campaigned in person and fought Chong at Gaoping, inflicting a great defeat.

units.zh: 崇與親騎十數人逾山而遁，中夜迷懵，不知所適，劫村民使為鄉導，誤趨晉州路，行百餘里方覺。
units.en: Chong fled over the mountains with a dozen horsemen. At midnight, lost, they forced villagers to guide them, took the road to Jinzhou by mistake, and went a hundred li before they knew it.
units.literal: Chong and a dozen close horsemen fled over the mountains. In the middle of the night, dazed, they did not know where they were going; they seized villagers to serve as guides, mistakenly took the road to Jinzhou, and had gone more than a hundred li before they realized.

units.zh: 崇怒，殺鄉導者，得他路而去，乃易名號，被毛褐、張樺笠而行。
units.en: Enraged, he killed the guides, changed route, assumed a false name, and traveled in fur coat and birch hat.
units.literal: Chong in anger killed the guides, took another road and left, then changed his name and title, wore a fur coat and birch-bark hat, and went on.

units.zh: 至沁州，與從者三五騎止於郊舍，寒餒尤甚，潛令告偽刺史李廷誨，廷誨饋盤餐、解衣裘而與之。
units.en: At Qinzhou he stopped with a few followers at a country inn, half frozen and starving. He secretly notified false prefect Li Tinghui, who fed him and gave him a fur robe.
units.literal: Reaching Qinzhou he halted with three or five followers at a country inn, suffering extreme cold and hunger. He secretly sent word to the false prefect Li Tinghui, who gave him a meal and lent him a fur robe.

units.zh: 每至屬邑，縣吏奉食，匕箸未舉，聞周師至，即蒼黃而去。
units.en: At each county clerks brought food, but before he could eat he heard Zhou troops were near and fled in panic.
units.literal: Whenever he reached a subordinate county the county clerks would offer food; before he had raised chopsticks and heard Zhou troops were coming he would flee in panic.

units.zh: 崇年老力憊，伏於馬上，日夜奔竄，僅能支持。
units.en: Old and spent, he lay on his horse and fled day and night, barely enduring.
units.literal: Chong was old and exhausted in strength; he lay prone on his horse, fleeing day and night, barely holding on.

units.zh: 距太原一舍，其子承鈞夜以兵百人迎之而入。
units.en: One stage from Taiyuan his son Chengjun met him at night with a hundred soldiers and brought him in.
units.literal: One stage from Taiyuan his son Chengjun came by night with a hundred soldiers to welcome him in.

units.zh: 及周師臨城下，崇氣懾，自固閉壘不出。
units.en: When Zhou troops reached the walls Chong was terrified, shut the gates, and would not come out.
units.literal: When Zhou troops reached below the walls Chong was cowed in spirit, fortified himself, and closed the ramparts without coming out.

units.zh: 月餘，世宗乃旋軍。
units.en: After more than a month Shizong withdrew.
units.literal: After more than a month Shizong withdrew the army.

units.zh: 顯德二年十一月，崇以病死，其子承鈞襲偽位。
units.en: In the eleventh month of Xiande's second year Chong died; Chengjun usurped the throne.
units.literal: In the eleventh month of the second year of Xiande Chong died of illness; his son Chengjun usurped his position.

units.zh: 鈞之事跡具皇家日曆。
units.en: Chengjun's career is recorded in the imperial calendar.
units.literal: Chengjun's deeds are fully recorded in the imperial calendar.

units.zh: 史臣曰：守光逆天反道，從古所無，迨至臨刑，尚求免死，非唯惡之極也，抑亦愚之甚也。
units.en: The historian writes: Shouguang defied Heaven and reversed the Way as few have since antiquity; at execution he still begged for life—wickedness and folly together.
units.literal: The historiographer says: Shouguang defied Heaven and reversed the Way—unheard of since antiquity. When he came to execution he still begged to escape death. This was not only wickedness at its height but also folly at its depth.

units.zh: 劉晟據南極以稱雄，屬中原之多事，洎乎奕世，遇我昌朝，力憊而亡，不泯其嗣，亦其幸也。
units.en: Liu Sheng held the far south while the heartland churned; through generations until our dynasty his house fell yet survived—a kind of fortune.
units.literal: Liu Sheng held the southern pole and called himself hero while the central plains were in many troubles. Through generations until our flourishing dynasty, when strength was spent they perished—yet their line was not extinguished; this too was their fortune.

units.zh: 劉崇以亡國之餘，竊偽王之號，多見其不知量也。
units.en: Liu Chong, a remnant of a fallen house, stole a king's title—he did not know his measure.
units.literal: Liu Chong, from the remnants of a perished state, stole the title of a false king—one often sees that he did not know his measure.

units.zh: 今元惡雖斃，遣孽尚存，勢蹙民殘，不亡何待！
units.en: Though the chief villain is dead, his brood remains; power is spent and the people ruined—how can they long endure?
units.literal: Now though the chief villain is dead, surviving spawn remain; their power is cramped and the people wasted—if they do not perish, what are they waiting for!
